functions.name: helium_hello
functions.description: Returns a constant, null-terminated C string identifying the library. Typical usage: call at any time to retrieve a read-only identifier for logging or diagnostics. The returned pointer refers to immutable storage; do not modify or free it. Lifetime/ownership are not documented.
requirements: Caller must not attempt to modify the returned string (const-qualified).
Caller must not attempt to free or deallocate the returned pointer.
Caller should treat the return as a null-terminated C string; lifetime/NULL-possibility are unspecified in the header.

functions.name: helium_sum
functions.description: Computes and returns the sum of two integers. Intended for general integer addition; no error reporting is specified.
requirements: Arguments a and b must be valid int values.
No guarantees are provided regarding overflow; behavior follows normal C/C++ int arithmetic.
